finite_spectrum_fit.scope: Six illustrative hierarchical masses and four PDG-2026-derived physical-current targets matched at finite vev. Source polynomial coefficients are fitted inputs, not a prediction of the golden relation.

mass_only_affine_candidate_search.scope: All real branches on a specified affine source-center slice, with fixed source vacuum, Higgs coefficients, messenger masses and illustrative mass inputs. The slice is not enforced against the other allowed scalar-center or kinetic operators.

sectors.overall_sign_equivalence: C and -C give the same masses and current magnitudes; the heaviest-mixing eigenvalue is fixed positive.

one_loop_theorem.proof: In the eigenbasis of Hermitian C, D is three real 2x2 blocks. Each scalar vertex is a real block coefficient times a Hermitian flavor matrix, plus a flavor-diagonal real Higgs vertex. Every paired G_ik G_ki is real, so each diagonal chirality-changing self-energy has zero phase separately.
one_loop_theorem.scalar_phase_exact: zero for every real neutral scalar mixing and positive scalar spectrum
one_loop_theorem.scope: Canonical bare metrics and the complete five-coefficient renormalizable fermion action; higher fermion operators and two-loop corrections are not covered.

polynomial_basis_exact_certificate.basis_independent_form: 8 [Im Tr(R2 T2 R T)]^3 in Hilbert-Schmidt coordinates
polynomial_basis_exact_certificate.proof: Exact symbolic Vandermonde factors and generic Hermitian off-diagonal identities; no fitted eigenprojector coefficients.

prediction_boundary.frame_statement: At fixed source centers, all allowed five-coefficient renormalizable fermion variations preserve their source eigenframes. Higher kinetic terms can change them.

protected_fixed_mass_response.scope: Full finite-spectrum masses fixed, canonical fermion metrics and all five real fermion coefficients unchanged. Allowed degree-at-most-eight scalar-center coefficients move four physical weak directions while preserving exact tree and one-loop mass-phase cancellation.

forbidden_at_renormalizable_order: H or eta insertion in Psi_L-Psi_R
renormalizable_fermion_certificate.new_scalar_content: one real Hermitian nonet and one real singlet per sector, odd under its corresponding Z2
renormalizable_fermion_certificate.scope: Complete renormalizable fermion census on this declared field content; derivative and higher scalar insertion operators are separate.
renormalizable_fermion_certificate.symmetry: 3.A6_u and Z2_up x Z2_down and generalized CP, with the retained scalar source groups

scalar_lock.proof: delta x^T A0 delta x + ||delta H-J delta x||^2; A0 positive. Congruence lower bound min(lambda_min(A0),1)/(1+||J||)^2.
scalar_lock.scope: Exact local positivity and unchanged base stationary point of the specified squared-lock scalar EFT, not global selection or a renormalizable scalar UV completion.
